editorial.intro: Compare ATR 42 and ATR 72 turboprop aircraft clipart with color profiles, airport scenes and black and white drawings.
paragraphs: The ATR 42 and ATR 72 share high wings and two propellers, but the ATR 72 has a longer cabin. Those shapes are easy to compare in this ATR aircraft clipart collection, especially in views where you can follow the row of passenger windows.

Choose from {{artworkCount}} illustrations, including parked planes, aircraft in flight and clean outlines. A side view works for a regional aviation comparison sheet, while a plane on the ground gives a travel journal a sense of arrival.

editorial.intro: Compare COMAC aircraft clipart of C909 and C919 passenger jets and illustrations of the C929 widebody concept.
paragraphs: Look at where the engines sit to tell the two featured COMAC airliners apart. The C909 has engines near the tail, while the C919 carries them under the wings. This COMAC aircraft clipart set also includes illustrations of the C929 widebody concept.

Choose among {{artworkCount}} designs for an airliner comparison sheet or personal aviation journal. Use an overhead or side view when you want the differences in wing shape, engine placement and cabin length to stand out.
